assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints are missing from the public site package; conceptual ranges only are proposed and no statutory value is fabricated.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for content scoring; statutory controls need official attachments and professional confirmation before any legal use.

assumptions.statement: All geometry is generated inside the provisional boundary (provisional_boundaries.geojson); measured areas (11,412,825 m2 site; 3,692,893 m2 key areas) deviate +0.11% / +0.24% from official text values and must be recalculated when official polygons are published.
assumptions.impact: Area-sensitive metrics (green ratio, land-use composition, building footprint) are provisional and will be recomputed on official geometry.

assumptions.statement: Land-use parcels, building massing, roads, green/public space and phasing are AI-generated conceptual suggestions, not statutory planning or approved schemes; keep/change/demolish is a concept judgement because ownership and current-condition basemaps are not publicly available.
assumptions.impact: Nothing in the package constitutes an approval basis or implementation commitment.

assumptions.statement: All 12 scenario cards, 3 industry test scenarios, 5 user personas and 3 landmarks are conceptual proposals that require scenario testing, data governance review and regulatory compliance validation before operation.
assumptions.impact: Scenario claims are proposals, not operational facts.

assumptions.statement: No commercial map tiles, non-public spatial data or un-cleared materials were used; no OSM data was used (own conceptual geometry), so no ODbL attribution obligations arise.
assumptions.impact: Source boundary is clean and auditable via sources.json.

# Human Review Checklist — Digital Rail v3

This checklist is deliberately not represented as an automated PASS. It identifies claims that require a qualified human, organizer, rights holder, or professional reviewer.

## Spatial and Planning Review

- [ ] Confirm official `SITE_BOUNDARY` polygon and three official `KEY_AREA` polygons when released.
- [ ] Recalculate all geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, HTML, and narrative numbers after official geometry arrives.
- [ ] Confirm the provisional LU-F001 residual parcel is not interpreted as a real residential allocation or existing-condition survey.
- [ ] Replace conceptual roads, buildings, land use, keep/change/demolish, heights, setbacks, and public-space boundaries with professionally reviewed proposals before statutory use.
- [ ] Confirm heritage, ecological, water, road-redline, rail, ownership, fire, utility, flood, and engineering constraints.
- [ ] Validate the 15-minute living-circle claim using a pedestrian network and verified public-service inventory.

## Accessibility and Public Interest

- [ ] Conduct an accessibility audit of every proposed route, crossing, station square, service point, and public facility.
- [ ] Test disabled, elderly, child, low-income tenant, night-worker, and digitally excluded user journeys with human participants or qualified reviewers.
- [ ] Complete relocation, rent burden, noise, night safety, public-resource allocation, and digital-exclusion impact assessments.
- [ ] Confirm manual, phone, cash, offline, and staffed fallbacks are funded and operationally owned.

## AI Governance and Safety

- [ ] For each of the 12 scenarios, approve data minimization, sensitive-data classification, access controls, retention, deletion, audit logs, appeals, human override, and shutdown criteria.
- [ ] Confirm health, emergency, digital-twin, robot, mobility, and education scenarios do not make autonomous high-impact decisions.
- [ ] Define independent incident reporting and KPI audit ownership.
- [ ] Confirm every conceptual KPI has a denominator, baseline, collection period, data owner, formula, and review cadence.

## Rights and Sources

- [ ] Verify the exact upstream repository licence for template/CSS reuse.
- [ ] Verify SimHei use for rendered outputs under the local installation terms; do not distribute the font file.
- [ ] Verify provider terms for generated text and graphics under the declared `COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY` scope.
- [ ] Verify every benchmark URL, publisher, claim, retrieval date, geographic scope, and licence before formal evidence use.
- [ ] Confirm the peer reference contains no copied text, geometry, or media.
- [ ] Confirm organizer rights to display, archive, derive, and potentially implement submitted work.

## Professional Deliverable Review

- [ ] Review every PDF page, not only the first page.
- [ ] Compare Chinese and English counterparts for substantive equivalence, not only file presence.
- [ ] Confirm all figures show title, language, scale, north arrow, legend, source/status note, and readable context.
- [ ] Confirm all numbers in narrative, JSON, figures, PDFs, and HTML reconcile.
- [ ] Confirm provisional and conceptual labels remain visible wherever a viewer could mistake a suggestion for an official plan.
